column12: stated on the filing, since the asset is outside the gate model (not big pharma) and the published NDA/BLA-to-approval rate assumes no negative vote. The case for lower: this is the second review after a complete response letter on effectiveness (July 2025), the hierarchy broke at LVEF (p=0.09) so the other secondary endpoints are nominal, the study is one trial of 106, and a BIMO inspection left a Form 483 on trial conduct. The study read the 18 human drug advisory committees; the Cellular, Tissue and Gene Therapies committee that voted here is a CBER committee and not one of them
